name: cavalry-officer
_doc: 기병 장교 (mounted officer): copy of cavalry-default (same horse, seat, anims) with the officer's equipment swapped in: officer service cap (dark field grey, brass), dark field-grey officer tunic + breeches with brass piping/stripe, tall boots, holster + map case, pistol (aim/fire one-handed, left hand on the reins) and sabre (charge/melee from the saddle, saddle scabbard). No carbine.
